title: Upper Savannah joint delivery allocation
scope_note: Internal proposed joint delivery allocation. Technical readiness, source selection and returned review do not accept a contract, authorize an invoice or record payment. Ecosystem Sciences retains scientific and prime/client interpretation; Bryce retains relationship and contract signature authority.

terms.included: One baseline and two prime-selected alternatives; one consolidated correction and one source/profile revision followed by the same three-run production cycle.

requirements.title: Land priorities for preventing future sediment loss
requirements.detail: Identify lands whose protection or responsible management reduces future sediment loss. Classification: issuer_requirement. Source: https://www.upstateforever.org/files/files/20261002_FINAL_EC-SDC%20Mapping%20RFP%20APPENDIX%20COMBINED.pdf; native PDF SHA256 04313cdda0b19f98b4081ef1eeec2f52707437759f9058f8d0e5abc8d83d6dbf; PDF page 2. Review evidence: Publish the map and its geospatial data and metadata.; Explain the disturbance or land-cover scenario, baseline, sediment model and ranking method..

allocation.prime: Select the disturbance/protection question and interpret sediment loss versus sediment delivered to streams.
allocation.engineering: Build both reviewed land-cover alternatives, retain original SDR runs and aligned baseline differences, and publish each alternative map with GIS and metadata.
allocation.receiving: Open both alternative maps and their original quantitative rasters; trace selected priorities to retained scenario and physical quantity.

requirements.title: Land priorities for reducing nutrient runoff
requirements.detail: Identify lands whose protection or management reduces nutrient runoff. Classification: issuer_requirement. Source: https://www.upstateforever.org/files/files/20261002_FINAL_EC-SDC%20Mapping%20RFP%20APPENDIX%20COMBINED.pdf; native PDF SHA256 04313cdda0b19f98b4081ef1eeec2f52707437759f9058f8d0e5abc8d83d6dbf; PDF page 2. Review evidence: Publish the map and its geospatial data and metadata.; Describe nitrogen and phosphorus contributions, their units, and the method used to combine or separately rank them..

allocation.prime: Choose how nitrogen and phosphorus should inform the future-impact question and review the scenario interpretation.
allocation.engineering: Produce original NDR baseline/alternative outputs and their separate N/P comparisons on common valid support.
allocation.receiving: Open the two future-impact releases and verify original N/P quantities, support and legends.

requirements.title: Land priorities for protecting drinking water
requirements.detail: Identify critical drinking-water protection areas through source-water relevance and sediment transfer. Classification: issuer_requirement. Source: https://www.upstateforever.org/files/files/20261002_FINAL_EC-SDC%20Mapping%20RFP%20APPENDIX%20COMBINED.pdf; native PDF SHA256 04313cdda0b19f98b4081ef1eeec2f52707437759f9058f8d0e5abc8d83d6dbf; PDF pages 1, 2, 8, 9. Review evidence: Relate modeled land priorities to the relevant source-water areas and drinking-water intakes.; Explain how sediment and nutrient pathways inform E. coli and cyanotoxin risk reduction..

allocation.prime: Confirm the authorized intake/protection geography and the scientific meaning of utility relevance.
allocation.engineering: Bind original utility geography and upstream membership to the retained source and quantitative scenario outputs.
allocation.receiving: Trace a drinking-water priority to its original feature, upstream context and selected model outputs.

requirements.title: Land priorities for high-quality water resources
requirements.detail: Identify important lands for protecting high-quality water resources, including outstanding-resource and trout waters. Classification: issuer_requirement. Source: https://www.upstateforever.org/files/files/20261002_FINAL_EC-SDC%20Mapping%20RFP%20APPENDIX%20COMBINED.pdf; native PDF SHA256 04313cdda0b19f98b4081ef1eeec2f52707437759f9058f8d0e5abc8d83d6dbf; PDF page 2. Review evidence: Record the authoritative water-resource designation data and vintage.; Document hydrologic connectivity or other method linking priority lands to those resources..

allocation.prime: Confirm applicable effective designations and the hydrologic relationship used for interpretation.
allocation.engineering: Retain original SCDES designations, source dates and explicit spatial relationship; publish priority geography and source-linked maps.
allocation.receiving: Open the designation source and priority layers together and inspect their recorded relationship.

requirements.title: Current nitrogen and phosphorus exports
requirements.detail: Show export rates under current land cover, using regional land-cover values and physical model inputs. Classification: issuer_requirement. Source: https://www.upstateforever.org/files/files/20261002_FINAL_EC-SDC%20Mapping%20RFP%20APPENDIX%20COMBINED.pdf; native PDF SHA256 04313cdda0b19f98b4081ef1eeec2f52707437759f9058f8d0e5abc8d83d6dbf; PDF pages 2, 9. Review evidence: Retain separately interpretable nitrogen and phosphorus values and their units.; Document precipitation, slope, erosion, land-cover parameters and modeled export pathway..

allocation.prime: Approve the regional profile and interpretation of current land-cover N/P export.
allocation.engineering: Run the original current-condition NDR selection and retain N/P rates, annual mass, units and lineage.
allocation.receiving: Inspect separate N/P rasters and regional totals against the actual grid and reporting mask.

requirements.title: Current sediment export
requirements.detail: Show present sediment export to waterways under current land cover. Classification: issuer_requirement. Source: https://www.upstateforever.org/files/files/20261002_FINAL_EC-SDC%20Mapping%20RFP%20APPENDIX%20COMBINED.pdf; native PDF SHA256 04313cdda0b19f98b4081ef1eeec2f52707437759f9058f8d0e5abc8d83d6dbf; PDF pages 2, 9. Review evidence: Provide the per-pixel export rate with mass/time or other actual model units declared.; Describe the erosion and transport calculations and hydrologic routing..

allocation.prime: Approve the current-condition SDR method and distinguish hillslope erosion from stream delivery.
allocation.engineering: Retain the selected SDR run and actual sediment outputs, rate-to-mass conversion and coverage.
allocation.receiving: Open the original sediment raster and totals with units and valid support.

requirements.title: Combined pollutant export presentation
requirements.detail: Present nitrogen, phosphorus and sediment exports together. Classification: issuer_requirement. Source: https://www.upstateforever.org/files/files/20261002_FINAL_EC-SDC%20Mapping%20RFP%20APPENDIX%20COMBINED.pdf; native PDF SHA256 04313cdda0b19f98b4081ef1eeec2f52707437759f9058f8d0e5abc8d83d6dbf; PDF page 2. Review evidence: Retain the component values and legend meaning.; State whether the combined display uses panels, a composite index or another method; document normalization and weights whenever applied..

allocation.prime: Choose and document any planning weights and normalization; retain interpretation of the separate physical components.
allocation.engineering: Publish the saved panels or explicit dimensionless combined index with original N/P/sediment companions.
allocation.receiving: Open the component values and saved weights/caps alongside the combined map.

requirements.title: 30 metre raster production grid
requirements.detail: Prepare all map data on a 30 m × 30 m raster grid. Classification: issuer_requirement. Source: https://www.upstateforever.org/files/files/20261002_FINAL_EC-SDC%20Mapping%20RFP%20APPENDIX%20COMBINED.pdf; native PDF SHA256 04313cdda0b19f98b4081ef1eeec2f52707437759f9058f8d0e5abc8d83d6dbf; PDF page 2. Review evidence: raster grid metadata; projection and units; pixel dimensions.

allocation.prime: Confirm the regional production grid and its distinction from commissioning examples.
allocation.engineering: Prepare and retain the required 30 m metric grid, affine origin, extent, masks and original transformation choices.
allocation.receiving: Inspect the grid metadata and original inputs in the reopened setup project.

requirements.title: Shared geospatial alignment
requirements.detail: For overlay and comparative interpretation, record each raster’s CRS, pixel size, grid origin, extent, mask and NoData value; document any alignment or resampling. Classification: engineering_acceptance. Source: https://www.upstateforever.org/files/files/20261002_FINAL_EC-SDC%20Mapping%20RFP%20APPENDIX%20COMBINED.pdf; native PDF SHA256 04313cdda0b19f98b4081ef1eeec2f52707437759f9058f8d0e5abc8d83d6dbf; PDF page 2. Review evidence: machine-readable raster manifest; per-layer alignment report.

allocation.prime: Review whether the selected grid and resampling support the intended scientific comparison.
allocation.engineering: Retain per-layer CRS, alignment, NoData, origin, coverage and transformation metadata.
allocation.receiving: Open representative source/prepared layers and inspect alignment on the exact retained grid.

requirements.title: Upper Savannah coverage
requirements.detail: Provide the requested individual maps, GIS data and metadata for the Upper Savannah River Basin in South Carolina. Classification: issuer_requirement. Source: https://www.upstateforever.org/files/files/20261002_FINAL_EC-SDC%20Mapping%20RFP%20APPENDIX%20COMBINED.pdf; native PDF SHA256 04313cdda0b19f98b4081ef1eeec2f52707437759f9058f8d0e5abc8d83d6dbf; PDF page 2. Review evidence: final basin and source-water geometry; coverage summary.

allocation.prime: Confirm the actual regional decision extent and intended reporting area.
allocation.engineering: Retain the Upper Savannah South Carolina reporting geometry separately from contributing upstream model geography.
allocation.receiving: Open both boundaries and coverage summaries without treating whole upstream area as reporting area.

requirements.title: Modeled basin buffer
requirements.detail: Include an area outside the Upper Savannah River Basin in modeling to improve ecosystem-based results; final map presentation may mask the external area. Classification: issuer_requirement. Source: https://www.upstateforever.org/files/files/20261002_FINAL_EC-SDC%20Mapping%20RFP%20APPENDIX%20COMBINED.pdf; native PDF SHA256 04313cdda0b19f98b4081ef1eeec2f52707437759f9058f8d0e5abc8d83d6dbf; PDF page 2. Review evidence: modeled extent and basin extent; buffer definition and rationale; separate analysis and display masks.

allocation.prime: Choose the scientifically appropriate upstream/exterior modeling support and record rationale.
allocation.engineering: Retain source and reporting masks separately and run on the declared exterior domain.
allocation.receiving: Inspect the domain, reporting mask and selected buffer rationale in the original project.

requirements.title: Targeted source-water context
requirements.detail: Retain the appendix’s source-water context for ARJWS and PRWD and the four mapped HUC12 areas when defining and presenting the actual project coverage. Classification: engineering_acceptance. Source: https://www.upstateforever.org/files/files/20261002_FINAL_EC-SDC%20Mapping%20RFP%20APPENDIX%20COMBINED.pdf; native PDF SHA256 04313cdda0b19f98b4081ef1eeec2f52707437759f9058f8d0e5abc8d83d6dbf; PDF pages 6, 8, 12, 14. Review evidence: utility intake/source-water relationship; HUC12 source identifiers; scope rationale.

allocation.prime: Confirm utility questions and any authoritative project-specific geographic refinements.
allocation.engineering: Preserve the four appendix HUC12 anchors and their distinct contributing unions with original identifiers.
allocation.receiving: Open ARJWS and PRWD anchors/unions and inspect deduplicated membership.

requirements.title: Publication map quality
requirements.detail: Produce high-resolution maps suitable for print and online use, including legend, scale and north arrow. Classification: issuer_requirement. Source: https://www.upstateforever.org/files/files/20261002_FINAL_EC-SDC%20Mapping%20RFP%20APPENDIX%20COMBINED.pdf; native PDF SHA256 04313cdda0b19f98b4081ef1eeec2f52707437759f9058f8d0e5abc8d83d6dbf; PDF page 2. Review evidence: exported map documents; legend, scale and north arrow on each map.

allocation.prime: Consolidate scientific/cartographic comments and approve intended audience wording.
allocation.engineering: Produce complete maps with legends, scale, north arrow, units and coherent comparison ranges.
allocation.receiving: Open every final print/web map at intended reading size and inspect GIS companions.

requirements.title: Final and working files
requirements.detail: Deliver final and working mapping/modeling files in high-resolution PDF and GIS formats and present the results to UF and its partners. Classification: issuer_requirement. Source: https://www.upstateforever.org/files/files/20261002_FINAL_EC-SDC%20Mapping%20RFP%20APPENDIX%20COMBINED.pdf; native PDF SHA256 04313cdda0b19f98b4081ef1eeec2f52707437759f9058f8d0e5abc8d83d6dbf; PDF page 3. Review evidence: final PDF collection; GIS data and project/workflow files; presentation materials.

allocation.prime: Confirm normal GIS/report receiving formats and prime presentation responsibilities.
allocation.engineering: Assemble high-resolution PDFs, editable GIS/source projects, report companions and complete application/Study.
allocation.receiving: Open final and working files in the selected receiving environment and repeat a saved export.

requirements.title: Geospatial metadata
requirements.detail: Complete associated metadata for all maps and GIS data; created geospatial data must be consistent with FGDC-endorsed standards. Classification: issuer_requirement. Source: https://www.upstateforever.org/files/files/20261002_FINAL_EC-SDC%20Mapping%20RFP%20APPENDIX%20COMBINED.pdf; native PDF SHA256 04313cdda0b19f98b4081ef1eeec2f52707437759f9058f8d0e5abc8d83d6dbf; PDF page 2. Review evidence: metadata per dataset; selected standard and conformance mapping; source lineage.

allocation.prime: Confirm required dataset conventions and prime source/license obligations.
allocation.engineering: Create dataset-specific FGDC-aligned metadata with original lineage and explicit selected standard.
allocation.receiving: Open each delivered dataset and its matching metadata/source references.

requirements.title: Accessible final report
requirements.detail: Provide a final report suitable for UF’s internal and external distribution, explaining methods and outcomes clearly for a lay reader. Classification: issuer_requirement. Source: https://www.upstateforever.org/files/files/20261002_FINAL_EC-SDC%20Mapping%20RFP%20APPENDIX%20COMBINED.pdf; native PDF SHA256 04313cdda0b19f98b4081ef1eeec2f52707437759f9058f8d0e5abc8d83d6dbf; PDF page 2. Review evidence: final report; method and result explanations; map-to-finding references.

allocation.prime: Own scientific conclusions, recommendations and client interpretation.
allocation.engineering: Compose the lay-reader report from exact source/run/map editions with methods, units and support.
allocation.receiving: Read the report and follow its findings to the same retained maps, tables and source.

requirements.title: November 1 delivery
requirements.detail: Complete the final maps, GIS data and associated metadata no later than November 1, 2027; the proposed schedule must demonstrate this deadline. Classification: issuer_requirement. Source: https://www.upstateforever.org/files/files/20261002_FINAL_EC-SDC%20Mapping%20RFP%20APPENDIX%20COMBINED.pdf; native PDF SHA256 04313cdda0b19f98b4081ef1eeec2f52707437759f9058f8d0e5abc8d83d6dbf; PDF pages 2, 3. Review evidence: project schedule; delivered product inventory.

allocation.prime: Set the integrated prime schedule and client review dates to meet the issuer deadline.
allocation.engineering: Schedule the proposed 30 active engineering days around actual input/review availability and retain delivered editions.
allocation.receiving: Confirm selected output dates and recipient handoff against the integrated schedule.

requirements.title: Consultant model recommendation
requirements.detail: Use a consultant-recommended ecosystem-service valuation and tradeoff modeling suite; InVEST or an equivalent software package may be used. Classification: issuer_requirement. Source: https://www.upstateforever.org/files/files/20261002_FINAL_EC-SDC%20Mapping%20RFP%20APPENDIX%20COMBINED.pdf; native PDF SHA256 04313cdda0b19f98b4081ef1eeec2f52707437759f9058f8d0e5abc8d83d6dbf; PDF pages 1, 2, 8, 9. Review evidence: model recommendation and rationale; version and parameter record.

allocation.prime: Select and justify the scientifically suitable model and version.
allocation.engineering: Retain the exact installed runtime, source parameters, arguments and reproducible native opening.
allocation.receiving: Open the model specification and actual runtime selections with the retained project.

requirements.title: Current-condition export interpretation
requirements.detail: Base current pollutant exports on current land cover and regional land-cover values, with per-pixel rates reflecting model inputs such as precipitation, slope and erosion. Classification: issuer_requirement. Source: https://www.upstateforever.org/files/files/20261002_FINAL_EC-SDC%20Mapping%20RFP%20APPENDIX%20COMBINED.pdf; native PDF SHA256 04313cdda0b19f98b4081ef1eeec2f52707437759f9058f8d0e5abc8d83d6dbf; PDF pages 2, 9. Review evidence: baseline dataset dates; per-pollutant units; regional parameter provenance.

allocation.prime: Approve source vintages and regional profile suitability for the intended baseline.
allocation.engineering: Retain original current land cover and climate/terrain/soil/profile inputs, quantities and original run outputs.
allocation.receiving: Inspect baseline sources and unit meanings before comparing alternatives.

requirements.title: Contaminant pathway explanation
requirements.detail: Explain sediment and nutrient transfer as the modeled pathways relevant to bacterial pollution and harmful algal blooms, and identify the separate water-sampling evidence used when interpreting contaminants. Classification: engineering_acceptance. Source: https://www.upstateforever.org/files/files/20261002_FINAL_EC-SDC%20Mapping%20RFP%20APPENDIX%20COMBINED.pdf; native PDF SHA256 04313cdda0b19f98b4081ef1eeec2f52707437759f9058f8d0e5abc8d83d6dbf; PDF pages 1, 8, 9. Review evidence: conceptual pathway description; modeled quantity definitions; sampling/model linkage.

allocation.prime: Interpret the separate field/laboratory observations and the limits of nutrient/sediment pathway inference.
allocation.engineering: Preserve constituent, fraction, catchment, period, method and qualifiers; produce compatible observed/model comparisons.
allocation.receiving: Read the conceptual pathway alongside original measurements without converting annual export into intake concentration.

requirements.title: Collaborative review
requirements.detail: Work with UF’s Clean Water Team and meet at predetermined intervals to review deliverables and obtain feedback on drafts. Classification: issuer_requirement. Source: https://www.upstateforever.org/files/files/20261002_FINAL_EC-SDC%20Mapping%20RFP%20APPENDIX%20COMBINED.pdf; native PDF SHA256 04313cdda0b19f98b4081ef1eeec2f52707437759f9058f8d0e5abc8d83d6dbf; PDF page 2. Review evidence: review schedule; draft versions; feedback and resolution records.

allocation.prime: Coordinate UF Clean Water Team meetings and consolidate actual scientific/client feedback.
allocation.engineering: Prepare coherent dated draft releases and retain comments, engineering dispositions and resulting editions.
allocation.receiving: Return review on the exact selected edition through the original Customer reviews workflow.

requirements.title: Relevant project experience
requirements.detail: Provide three to five similar project descriptions covering the previous five years, with a maximum of two pages per project. Classification: issuer_requirement. Source: https://www.upstateforever.org/files/files/20261002_FINAL_EC-SDC%20Mapping%20RFP%20APPENDIX%20COMBINED.pdf; native PDF SHA256 04313cdda0b19f98b4081ef1eeec2f52707437759f9058f8d0e5abc8d83d6dbf; PDF page 3. Review evidence: project descriptions; relevant dates and roles; page counts.

allocation.prime: Select 3–5 actual comparable projects from the previous five years and authorize references to firm work.
allocation.engineering: Provide factual engineering contribution descriptions and format source-backed project material for the prime.
allocation.receiving: Check actual project dates, role attribution and the two-page-per-project limit.

requirements.title: Team qualifications
requirements.detail: Provide an organizational chart and short biographies or resumes for the people performing the work, with one page per person. Classification: issuer_requirement. Source: https://www.upstateforever.org/files/files/20261002_FINAL_EC-SDC%20Mapping%20RFP%20APPENDIX%20COMBINED.pdf; native PDF SHA256 04313cdda0b19f98b4081ef1eeec2f52707437759f9058f8d0e5abc8d83d6dbf; PDF page 3. Review evidence: organization chart; named team resumes; page counts.

allocation.prime: Name the prime team, scientific roles and authorized biographies.
allocation.engineering: Provide actual engineering role/capability material and compose the team allocation.
allocation.receiving: Review the organization chart and one-page-per-person biographies.

requirements.title: Comparable-work references
requirements.detail: Provide references from two organizations for comparable completed work, within one page; the stated exception applies to firms that completed at least two UF projects in the past two years. Classification: issuer_requirement. Source: https://www.upstateforever.org/files/files/20261002_FINAL_EC-SDC%20Mapping%20RFP%20APPENDIX%20COMBINED.pdf; native PDF SHA256 04313cdda0b19f98b4081ef1eeec2f52707437759f9058f8d0e5abc8d83d6dbf; PDF page 3. Review evidence: two organization references or documented UF exception; page count.

allocation.prime: Supply the two authorized comparable-work references or actual qualifying UF exception.
allocation.engineering: Format the authorized reference information within the issuer requirement.
allocation.receiving: Check source contact authorization and one-page reference section.

requirements.title: Proposed project schedule
requirements.detail: Describe a project schedule demonstrating completion by November 1, 2027, within two pages. Classification: issuer_requirement. Source: https://www.upstateforever.org/files/files/20261002_FINAL_EC-SDC%20Mapping%20RFP%20APPENDIX%20COMBINED.pdf; native PDF SHA256 04313cdda0b19f98b4081ef1eeec2f52707437759f9058f8d0e5abc8d83d6dbf; PDF page 3. Review evidence: dated schedule; page count.

allocation.prime: Choose actual kickoff/review dates and prime/client dependencies.
allocation.engineering: Provide the proposed staged engineering calendar and named outputs for the integrated two-page schedule.
allocation.receiving: Confirm the schedule meets November 1, 2027 without treating proposed active days as accepted calendar dates.

requirements.title: Inclusive project fee
requirements.detail: Include a proposed fee and expected expenses with a total project cost no greater than $50,000; cover data preparation, model scenarios, meetings, travel, maps and the final report within a maximum ten-page fee section. Classification: issuer_requirement. Source: https://www.upstateforever.org/files/files/20261002_FINAL_EC-SDC%20Mapping%20RFP%20APPENDIX%20COMBINED.pdf; native PDF SHA256 04313cdda0b19f98b4081ef1eeec2f52707437759f9058f8d0e5abc8d83d6dbf; PDF page 3. Review evidence: itemized fee and expenses; inclusive total; page count.

allocation.prime: Own the inclusive prime fee, expenses and procurement commitment within the issuer ceiling.
allocation.engineering: Provide the proposed USD18,600 engineering scope/milestones and explicit changes or external cost inputs.
allocation.receiving: Review the complete prime budget, expenses and fee section against USD50,000; the remaining allocation is not profit.

requirements.title: Proposal and firm contacts
requirements.detail: Include at least two proposal contacts with name, email, mailing address and telephone, plus the firm’s name, physical address and website, within one page. Classification: issuer_requirement. Source: https://www.upstateforever.org/files/files/20261002_FINAL_EC-SDC%20Mapping%20RFP%20APPENDIX%20COMBINED.pdf; native PDF SHA256 04313cdda0b19f98b4081ef1eeec2f52707437759f9058f8d0e5abc8d83d6dbf; PDF page 3. Review evidence: contact details; firm details; page count.

allocation.prime: Select at least two authorized proposal contacts and actual firm contact information.
allocation.engineering: Prepare the contact section from authorized source information.
allocation.receiving: Check names, addresses, email/telephone and the one-page section.

requirements.title: Complete electronic PDF submission
requirements.detail: Submit one complete proposal in PDF format by email, labeled Response to EC-SDC Mapping RFP, to Josie Newton at jnewton@upstateforever.org. Classification: issuer_requirement. Source: https://www.upstateforever.org/files/files/20261002_FINAL_EC-SDC%20Mapping%20RFP%20APPENDIX%20COMBINED.pdf; native PDF SHA256 04313cdda0b19f98b4081ef1eeec2f52707437759f9058f8d0e5abc8d83d6dbf; PDF page 3. Review evidence: one complete PDF; submission label and recipient.

allocation.prime: Own final prime proposal selection and submission through the owner-authorized relationship.
allocation.engineering: Prepare the complete labeled PDF and coherent engineering attachments for internal selection.
allocation.receiving: Open the selected complete PDF and verify all required sections before any separately authorized send.

requirements.title: November 6 proposal deadline
requirements.detail: The proposal must be received by 5:00 p.m. Eastern Time on November 6, 2026. Classification: issuer_requirement. Source: https://www.upstateforever.org/files/files/20261002_FINAL_EC-SDC%20Mapping%20RFP%20APPENDIX%20COMBINED.pdf; native PDF SHA256 04313cdda0b19f98b4081ef1eeec2f52707437759f9058f8d0e5abc8d83d6dbf; PDF page 3. Review evidence: receipt timestamp.

allocation.prime: Own the final submission timetable and actual issuer receipt.
allocation.engineering: Provide the engineering proposal material early enough for prime composition and review.
allocation.receiving: Retain the actual deadline and, when supplied, the real submission receipt.

requirements.title: Anticipated selection period
requirements.detail: UF anticipates choosing a consultant in December 2026 and confirming selection by the end of January 2027; the evaluation team may conduct interviews. Classification: issuer_process. Source: https://www.upstateforever.org/files/files/20261002_FINAL_EC-SDC%20Mapping%20RFP%20APPENDIX%20COMBINED.pdf; native PDF SHA256 04313cdda0b19f98b4081ef1eeec2f52707437759f9058f8d0e5abc8d83d6dbf; PDF page 3. Review evidence: procurement schedule.

allocation.prime: Own issuer discussions and the actual procurement outcome.
allocation.engineering: Keep the engineering source and commercial proposal current as requested by the prime.
allocation.receiving: Record any actual issuer selection communication separately from application readiness.

requirements.title: Project contract terms
requirements.detail: The RFP calls for a negotiated, executed contract before contracted work begins and states that UF does not pay proposal-preparation or pre-contract costs. Classification: issuer_process. Source: https://www.upstateforever.org/files/files/20261002_FINAL_EC-SDC%20Mapping%20RFP%20APPENDIX%20COMBINED.pdf; native PDF SHA256 04313cdda0b19f98b4081ef1eeec2f52707437759f9058f8d0e5abc8d83d6dbf; PDF page 4. Review evidence: executed project agreement when awarded.

allocation.prime: Negotiate the project agreement; Bryce personally reviews and signs any TJLabs contract.
allocation.engineering: Maintain the scoped proposed workshare and named input/output dependencies for contract preparation.
allocation.receiving: Keep actual executed agreement metadata separate from technical review and readiness.

requirements.title: Community context traceability
requirements.detail: Use the appendix’s 17 block-group records as attributed context, keeping population, household counts, income and household poverty measurements distinct. Classification: engineering_acceptance. Source: https://www.upstateforever.org/files/files/20261002_FINAL_EC-SDC%20Mapping%20RFP%20APPENDIX%20COMBINED.pdf; native PDF SHA256 04313cdda0b19f98b4081ef1eeec2f52707437759f9058f8d0e5abc8d83d6dbf; PDF pages 7, 8, 15, 16. Review evidence: source table identity; record-level units and definitions.

allocation.prime: Review how appendix community measures support the project narrative and keep geographic meanings distinct.
allocation.engineering: Retain all17 original block-group records and the original population/household/income/poverty definitions.
allocation.receiving: Open complete original context tables and keep utility-service populations separate.

requirements.title: Customer review and receiving
requirements.detail: Bind the final review to exact source, run, delivery and archive identities; preserve reviewer comments and decisions with the packet so the recipient can reopen the same products. Classification: engineering_acceptance. Source: https://www.upstateforever.org/files/files/20261002_FINAL_EC-SDC%20Mapping%20RFP%20APPENDIX%20COMBINED.pdf; native PDF SHA256 04313cdda0b19f98b4081ef1eeec2f52707437759f9058f8d0e5abc8d83d6dbf; PDF pages 2, 3. Review evidence: original Workspace review export; recipient decisions; reopened archive/product identities.

allocation.prime: Choose the receiving operator and confirm scientific/client interpretation after operating the delivered project.
allocation.engineering: Deliver complete exact original files and application/runtime instructions, preserve correction history and independent reopening.
allocation.receiving: Operate the exact received project, inspect every outgoing attachment and return any findings through the original review.

inputs.title: Project-specific intake and protection geography
inputs.needed: Provide only authorized intake/protection files or corrections that are not available in the retained public sources; identify effective edition and use restrictions.
inputs.public_context: Public basin geometry, four appendix anchors, original WBD upstream links and public water classifications remain independently available.

inputs.title: Scientific method and coefficient decisions
inputs.needed: Select scientifically appropriate profile lineage, coefficient adjustments, model support and interpretation from the concrete retained setup results.
inputs.public_context: Retained original model documentation, regional reference profiles and public source/coverage comparisons are available for review.

inputs.title: Two intended management or development alternatives
inputs.needed: Choose the actual decision questions, eligible geographic masks and class transitions for the two included alternatives.
inputs.public_context: The application can edit scenarios and retain exact baseline/alternative selections; commissioning examples retain their own identity.

inputs.title: Authorized local observations and intended use
inputs.needed: Provide project-specific licensed/local observations with original station/catchment, date/time, units, constituent/fraction, methods and qualifiers; select their calibration or independent assessment role.
inputs.public_context: Existing public observations and prior studies remain retrievable and retained independently; public gaps are not requests for the client to do collection work.

inputs.title: Recipient operating environment
inputs.needed: Identify the intended recipient OS/GIS tools, available runtime and normal opening/export route, and name the receiving operator.
inputs.public_context: The maintained application supplies a complete local working-project route and readable reports; existing equipped receiving remains available for preparation.

inputs.title: Prime and client review timing
inputs.needed: Select actual setup, modeled-draft and consolidated-correction review dates around the field/client calendar; identify who consolidates scientific and UF feedback.
inputs.public_context: The proposed engineering allocation and issuer November 1, 2027 delivery deadline are retained; the active engineering duration is distinct from calendar waiting.

inputs.title: Prime qualifications and authorized proposal information
inputs.needed: Provide actual comparable projects, named team/biographies, authorized references, firm contacts and prime fee/expense decisions needed for the issuer proposal.
inputs.public_context: Issuer page limits, proposal structure, public firm context and the scoped engineering offer are already retained.
